home.tagline: A free, open-source PDF reader and editor with full Arabic support
home.drop: or drag and drop a file here
card.ocrDesc: Make scanned files searchable (Arabic and English)
card.compressDesc: Reduce file size by compressing images
compress.already: The file is already compact ({size}) — nothing to reduce
compress.done: Size reduced from {before} to {after} (−{pct}%) — save the file
export.noText: This document has no text — run “Recognize text (OCR)” first
export.docxNote: — complex layout such as tables and columns is not preserved
redact.hint: Drag on the page to mark what to redact, or search:
redact.searchPlaceholder: Text or number to redact on every page
redact.nothing: Mark the areas to redact first
redact.confirmBody: The marked content ({n} marks on {pages} pages) will be permanently removed from the file and replaced with black boxes.
redact.confirmNote: To guarantee real removal, redacted pages are converted to images: their text can no longer be selected or searched. Other pages are not affected.
redact.done: Redacted — save the file under a new name
org.encryptedWarn: Note: applying page changes produces a copy without a password
org.pendingTitle: You have page changes that haven’t been applied
merge.needTwo: Choose two or more files to merge
images.title: Create PDF from images
images.a4: A4 with margins (portrait or landscape to suit the image)
ocr.done: Text recognized on {pages} pages (approx. accuracy {conf}%) — you can now search and copy
ocr.allHaveText: Every page already has searchable text — choose “All pages” to recognize again
ocr.progressTurn: Recognizing text… page {i} of {n} (trying another orientation)
ocr.noneFound: No text found on the scanned pages
handsign.placeHint: Drag the signature into place and resize it from the corners
hand.title: Create signature
hand.drawHint: Sign inside the box with your mouse or pen
hand.pickImage: Choose a signature image (PNG with a transparent background works best)
sec.signedBody: {action} rewrites the file, which will invalidate its existing digital signatures.
sec.signedNote: If you need both signatures and protection: protect or edit the document first, then sign it. Adding new signatures or comments doesn’t invalidate earlier signatures.
protect.title: Protect document with a password
protect.preset.readOnly: Read, print and copy only — no editing
protect.preset.noCopy: Read and print only — no copying or editing
protect.preset.noPrint: Read only — no printing, copying or editing
protect.note: The file is encrypted with AES-256. A forgotten password can’t be recovered.
protect.tooShort: The password is too short (at least 4 characters)
protect.ownerSame: The owner password must differ from the open password
protect.removed: Protection removed — save the file to keep the change
sign.title: Sign with a certificate
sign.reason2: I am the author of this document
sign.useTsa: Add a trusted timestamp (TSA) — proves the signing time; needs internet
sign.useLtv: Embed long-term validation data (LTV) — keeps the signature verifiable offline
sign.needIdentity: Choose a digital ID file or create a new ID
sign.badTsaUrl: Enter a valid timestamp server URL starting with http
sign.tsaFailedNote: You can sign without a timestamp; your computer’s time will be used, and the signature won’t remain verifiable once your certificate expires or is revoked.
sign.placeHint: Drag a rectangle on the page to place the signature — Esc to cancel
id.title: Create a new digital ID
id.name: Full name
id.note: This is a self-signed ID: it proves the document hasn’t changed since you signed it, but it isn’t issued by a recognized certificate authority. A public certificate file (.cer) is saved alongside it for colleagues to add to their trusted certificates. For official signatures, use a certificate from a certificate authority.
id.pwTooShort: The password must be at least 6 characters
id.created: Digital ID created; its public certificate (.cer) was saved alongside it
sig.bannerEncrypted: The document is encrypted — its digital signatures can’t be verified
sig.removeProtectionToVerify: Remove protection to verify the signatures
sig.none: This document has no digital signatures
ltv.added: Validation data embedded: {certs} certificates, {ocsps} OCSP responses, {crls} revocation lists
changes.none: The document hasn’t changed since this signature
changes.signatures: Only later signatures were added — the signature remains valid
changes.form: Form fields were filled in after signing
changes.annotations: Comments were added after signing — the signed content is unchanged
changes.modified: The document’s content was changed after this signature
trust.trusted: Trusted — chains to a trusted certificate authority
trust.self-signed: Self-signed ID — not trusted on this computer
trust.untrusted-root: The root certificate authority isn’t among the trusted certificates
trust.incomplete: Incomplete certificate chain — no root certificate authority reached
trust.expired: A certificate in the chain wasn’t valid at signing time
trust.invalid-ca: A certificate in the chain isn’t allowed to issue certificates
rev.revokedAfter: Certificate “{cn}” was revoked on {date}, after signing{why}. The signature stays valid because its time is proven by a timestamp
rev.offline: Not checked — online checking is turned off in settings
rev.na: No revocation service for this certificate (self-signed or manually trusted)
ts.none: None — signing time comes from the signer’s computer clock
ts.untrusted: Valid, but the timestamp authority “{tsa}” isn’t trusted
status.broken: Invalid signature: the signed content was tampered with or the signature is damaged
status.revoked: {cn}’s certificate was revoked — the signature is invalid
status.modified: The document’s content was changed after it was signed
status.revocationUnknown: The signature is intact, but revocation couldn’t be checked
status.untrustedOne: The signature is intact, but {cn}’s identity isn’t trusted
panel.title: Digital signatures
panel.tampered: Invalid signature — the signed content was tampered with
panel.intact: Intact — the signed content is unchanged
panel.ltvYes: Validation data embedded — verifiable offline, even after the certificates expire
panel.ltvNo: Not embedded — verification needs the internet
panel.notValidAtSigning: The certificate wasn’t valid at signing time
panel.note: REA PDF checks the integrity of the signed content, what changed after each signature, whether the certificate chains to a trusted authority, that it isn’t revoked (OCSP, then CRL), and any timestamp. Validation data embedded in the file (LTV) is used first, then the internet.
trustDlg.title: Trust a certificate
trustDlg.body: The certificate “{cn}” will be added to your trusted certificates, and signatures it issued will be trusted on this computer.
trustDlg.note: Only trust a certificate you’ve confirmed, for example by matching its fingerprint with its owner:
manage.title: Trusted certificates
manage.onlineDesc: Contacts certificate authority servers (OCSP/CRL) when a signed document is opened.
manage.empty: No certificates added yet. Certificates from authorities in the Windows store are trusted automatically.
err.openFailed: Couldn’t open the file — it may be damaged or not a PDF
err.decryptDesktopOnly: Decryption is only available in the desktop app
err.desktopOnly: This feature is available in the desktop app
err.id_no_key: The file doesn’t contain a private key and certificate
err.incremental_failed: Couldn’t create an incremental update of the file
err.sig_id_mismatch: The signer identifier in the signature doesn’t match its certificate; other validators will reject it
err.no_signatures: The document has no digital signatures
err.ltv_nothing: No revocation data to embed — the certificates may be self-signed, or online checking is off
err.tsa_rejected: The timestamp server rejected the request (HTTP {status})
err.tsa_denied: The timestamp server didn’t grant a timestamp
err.tsa_mismatch: The timestamp doesn’t match the signature
err.ts_wrong_signature: The timestamp doesn’t belong to this signature
err.ts_bad_tsa_signature: The timestamp server’s signature is invalid or its certificate is missing
err.not_a_certificate: The file isn’t a valid certificate
form.highlightTitle: Show a tinted background on fillable fields
form.editFieldsTitle: Move, resize, edit and delete fields
form.placeHint: Drag a rectangle or click on the page to add a {type} — Esc to cancel
form.name: Field name
form.radioNote: Only one button can be selected among buttons sharing a group name.
form.noDots: The name can’t contain a dot
form.valueNotOption: The default value isn’t one of the options
form.needExport: Enter a value for this option
form.unsupported: This kind of field can’t be edited
sign.intoField: The signature will be placed in the field “{name}”.
tool.noteTitle: Add a sticky note: click on the page
tool.reviewTitle: Review the document with others through a shared folder
mail.draftReady: A draft was created in Outlook — review it and send it yourself
cm.noteHint: Click on the page to place the note — Esc to cancel
cm.deleteBody: The comment and all its replies will be deleted.
cm.nameNote: This name appears on your comments and replies, and names your comments file in shared reviews.
review.bar: Shared review “{title}” — comments from {n} reviewer(s). Saving publishes only your comments.
review.published: Your comments were published to the review folder
review.notInReview: This document isn’t part of a shared review
review.started: The review has started. Share the folder path with the reviewers.
review.startNote: Choose a folder every reviewer can reach: a network share or a synced SharePoint/OneDrive folder. A copy of the document goes there and each reviewer’s comments are kept in their own file (XFDF), so edits never conflict.
review.name: Review name
review.emails: Reviewers’ e-mail for an Outlook invitation (optional)
review.emailsNote: The invitation is created as an Outlook draft for you to review and send.
review.mailBody: {name} invites you to review and comment on “{title}”. Open the file from the shared folder:
review.mailHow: Open the file in REA PDF, add your comments and press Save to publish them. Sync shows the others’ comments.
route.title: Request signatures in order
route.note: List the signers in order, then mark where each one signs. After every signature REA PDF prepares an Outlook draft to the next signer with the document attached — nothing is sent automatically.
route.subject: Subject
route.signers: Signers in order (one per line: name and e-mail)
route.initiatorEmail: Your e-mail for the final copy
route.placeHint: Drag a rectangle where {name} signs ({i} of {n}) — Esc to cancel
route.ready: The document is ready for signing
route.draftBody: Create an e-mail draft to {name} <{email}> with the document attached?
route.draftDoneBody: Everyone has signed. Create an e-mail draft to the initiator {name} <{email}> with the final copy attached?
route.draftNote: The message is saved to Outlook Drafts and opened for you to review and send.
route.mailBody: Attached is “{title}” for your signature (signature {step} of {n}).
route.mailHow: Open the attachment in REA PDF and click “Click to sign” in the field with your name; REA PDF then prepares the message to the next signer.
route.mailDone: All {n} signatures on “{title}” are complete. The final copy is attached.
edit.textTitle: Click a line to rewrite or delete it
edit.imagesTitle: Move, resize, replace and delete images
edit.textHint: Click any line of text to edit it
edit.imageHint: Drag an image to move it, the handle to resize (Shift to change proportions)
edit.fontNote: The original text is really removed from the file; the new text is written in an embedded IBM Plex Sans Arabic font, in the original line’s color and position, and stays searchable and copyable.
edit.needText: Enter the new text or choose Delete line
edit.longer: The new text is longer than the original line and may overflow
err.edit_text_not_found: The line’s text wasn’t found in the page content (it may be inside a grouped object or an image)
err.edit_image_not_found: The image wasn’t found in the page content
err.no_mail_app: No mail app is installed on this device
err.ocr_unavailable: The text recognition engine couldn’t start
